title: The Ink Thief of Sablewick
story: Sablewick the Ink Siphon has drunk from the great library's ink reservoir, which held 480 liters this morning. He swallowed three-eighths of it before the scribes noticed, and then coughed 45 liters back up when Mr 6 startled him with a sneeze.
question: How many liters of ink are in the reservoir now?
hint: First work out three-eighths of 480 — divide by 8, then multiply by 3. Take that away, then add the coughed-up ink back.
victory: Mr 6 recounted the reservoir at 345 liters and Sablewick, thoroughly out-audited, agreed to work as the library's ink-refiller for a hundred years.
imagePrompt: A long inky serpent-siphon creature curled around a giant brass ink reservoir in a candlelit library of towering bookshelves, dark droplets everywhere, with a numeral-six knight holding a measuring rod.
